name: Grandpa Gus
bio: Pulled the tarp off the Bucket in Dirt Crown. Still has opinions about tyre pressure.

portrait.subject: a cute cheerful grandpa mechanic with a grey mustache, a backwards trucker cap, oil-stained overalls and a wrench, thumbs up
portrait.background: dusty dirt race track at sunset

request: Gus here, from Dirt Crown. Got a racer for ya. The Bucket. Friends first? 🏁
hello: Atta kid! Let's get you some coins for parts.
The Bucket ain't pretty, but she's honest.
about: I'm Gus. Raced dirt for fifty years. Now my grandkid drives my old racer, the Bucket, and I bolt on the parts.
how: Race dirt tracks, win coins, and bolt on parts that show on the car: exhausts, scoops, superchargers, wings, bigger tyres.
tips: Tyres before engine. Grip wins dirt races.
Brake before the corner, gas out of it.
Every part shows on the car. Make her look mean!
chat: Found my old trophy in the shed. It's a bucket. Fitting.
Your grandma says I talk about carburettors too much.
Changed the oil. Changed it again. Felt good.
A rival called the Bucket 'cute'. We'll see who's cute at the finish.
nudge: Race day! Get in the Bucket, kid!
New part's arrived at the garage. Let's bolt it on!
idle: {ago} since you raced! The Bucket's getting dusty. Well, dustier.
The garage has been quiet for {ago}, kid.
progress: You've got {gold} coins in the jar! That's a supercharger, kid! 🏁

questions.q: What's the first part you'd bolt on?

update: Garage news: Dirt Crown is now v{version}! New parts maybe!
bye: Keep it in the dirt, kid! 🏁
